en.html:
The besieging army coming from Fujisawa was following the textbook with full devotion.
First, long-range shelling and bombing by dragoons. Once our defensive fire weakened, send the armored units forward.

But ours was Fudaraku Fortress, quite shameless in declaring itself the greatest in all Yamato's military history. Between bombardments, it recovered its defenses and poured crossfire from the batteries, pushing the enemy back.

Forward, back. Attack, defense. The argument continued, growing louder and fiercer all the time.

en.html:
Kageaki"...The Horigoe contingent is doing good work."
Chachamaru"You think so?"
Kageaki"Hard to believe they have been away from actual combat for more than six years."
Chachamaru"Arre, that much is natural. Not all these fellows spent the six years since the great war sitting idle."
Kageaki"...Of course. So many rebellions. Experience putting them down, they would naturally have."
Chachamaru"That also. But more the opposite, actually."
Kageaki"The opposite...?"
Chachamaru"Plenty of my junior officers are fellows who fought the previous Lord of Horigoe. Prison, exile, all that. After I killed the bastard, I gathered them up."
Chachamaru"So a hopeless fight against some huge army? Bhai, they've been through that particular chutiyapa before."
Kageaki"............I see."

en.html:
She pointed to the flying ship sitting far above us.

Not just an airship. Not merely a military airship either.
The largest flying vessel in the world. If being enormous was work, this thing was doing overtime.

A Galley Keep-class heavy airship.
Its bomb load was the largest too, in proportion to its huge body. Its capacity as a dragoon carrier was on the same unmatched scale.

A flying fortress. No exaggeration required.

Chachamaru"That thing works as their base, na. Their dragoons keep the height advantage and come at us again and again. We beat them back, they come back. No end to the fucking service."
Chachamaru"Try gathering our forces to storm that flying fortress, and those Stealth Draco come out and screw up the whole effort."
Kageaki"..."
Kageaki"Really no move left, then."
Chachamaru"No move, sir. Full dead end. In modern war, starting late is a very effective way of ending early."
Kageaki"In the air, are we losing about four for every one of theirs?"

Kageaki"...Not exactly a solution, but..."
Chachamaru"Haan?"

Chachamaru"...Stop fighting at a disadvantage, save our air strength? Haan, one option."

Kageaki"The huge fellow up there starts working as a bomber as well as a carrier?"
Chachamaru"Exactly. We pull our dragoons down, why WOULDN'T they?"

en.html:
There was a tactic called assault bombing.
With dragoons escorting it, an airship descended low and bombed the enemy positions accurately.

If it worked, the results were considerable. But there was also a serious danger of enemy dragoons or ground-based antiaircraft guns bringing the ship down. Considerable results could happen to the ship as well. The attacker had a serious decision to make.

Grounding our dragoons would reduce the danger for them.
Chachamaru's worry, I understood.

強襲爆撃という戦術がある。
　護衛竜騎兵に身辺を守らせながら飛行艦が低空まで
降下、敵陣に対して高精度の爆撃を行うというものだ。

　成功すれば戦果は大きいが、敵の竜騎兵による攻撃
や地上からの対空射撃を食らって飛行艦が沈められる
危険もまた大きい。

当たっての危険を減らしてやる事になるだろう。
　茶々丸の懸念は理解できた。

Chachamaru"...Arre, shit. My brain had become pure military idiot."
Kageaki"Yes. They are thinking of what comes after winning the war."
Kageaki"How to rule with the citizens' support, instead of making enemies of them."
Chachamaru"...Bomb Fudaraku's center, one thing. Bomb the edges, and there's a good chance the damage spreads into the surrounding area. Their own troops, they can pull back."
Chachamaru"The land won't get up and move, na. And this Fujisawa approach is closer to the city than much of Fudaraku's perimeter."
Kageaki"They have probably evacuated the residents already... but some may not have got out. Fire could spread to districts not yet evacuated. Even if nobody is there, destroy people's neighborhoods and they will hardly think well of you."
Kageaki"It would obstruct their postwar rule."
Chachamaru"Then they won't do it. At least while they think they're so far ahead they can win without it."
Kageaki"Yes. Besides, the advantage in the air is already quite clear. If they intended assault bombing, they would have done it by now."
Chachamaru"Correct. ...Tch. My decision came late."
Chachamaru"How many died for nothing while my brain was taking its time?"
Kageaki"..."
Chachamaru"Valuable fighting strength. Have to look after it, even starting now. Thanks, bhai."
Kageaki"Yes..."

景明「戦後の統治に支障をきたす」
茶々丸「となれば、やらねえわな。 　少なくとも自分てめーらが圧倒的に有利で、そこ までせんでも勝てるって思ってるうちは」
景明「ああ。 　大体、空の戦闘の優劣がこれだけはっきり しているのだ。強襲爆撃をやる気があれば、 とっくにやっている」
茶々丸「ごもっとも。 　……ちっ、判断が遅れちまった」
茶々丸「この遅れで何人無駄に死んだかな」
景明「…………」
茶々丸「貴重な戦力だ。今からでも大事にせんとね。 　ありがと、お兄さん」
景明「ああ……」

en.html:
Chachamaru called her staff over and gave them brief orders.
At first they looked surprised. Then, apparently understanding, they scattered in a hurry to carry them out.

Signalmen shouting, messengers running—the noise around us suddenly had still more to say.

ja.html:
茶々丸は幕僚を呼び寄せ、手短に指示を下した。
　命じられた側は初め驚いたものの、すぐ呑み込んだ
らしく、指示を実行に移すため慌しく散ってゆく。

　通信兵の叫びと駆け回る伝令兵の足音とで、周囲の
喧騒は俄かに厚みを増した。

en.html:
Chachamaru"Still, once we pull the dragoons out, things here get a lot harder. Airship bombing, maybe not. But the bomb-carrying Fire Draco will come visiting in full numbers."
Kageaki"Keeping our air strength intact matters more."
Chachamaru"No argument there. Other thing to watch for... dropping in to attack, na."
Kageaki"The Grapplers? Ground-combat dragoons?"
Chachamaru"Haan. I don't think antiaircraft guns will keep those airborne assault fellows out. The dragoons we bring down need to be ready to fight them."
Kageaki"Still a fight against the odds... but surely no worse than four of ours for one of theirs."
Chachamaru"Our ground, our kind of fight. Some disadvantage we can handle, yaar."

ja.html:
茶々丸「ただ何にしろ、竜騎兵を引き上げちまうと、 こっちはだいぶ苦しくなるね。 　飛行艦での爆撃は無くても、爆装竜騎兵ファイアードラコは 大挙しておいでなさるだろうし」
景明「航空戦力を保持しておく方が重要だろう」
茶々丸「そいつは間違いない。 　あと気をつけておかなきゃならんのは…… 降下襲撃か」
景明「制陸戦用竜騎兵グラップラー？」
茶々丸「うん。高射砲であの降下猟兵どもの侵入を 阻止できるとは思えんから。 　下ろした竜騎兵に応戦の用意をさせておく 必要があるな」
景明「それも不利な勝負だが…… 　損害比一対四より酷くなる事はあるまい」
茶々丸「こっちの土俵でこっちの得意な喧嘩になる からね。 　多少の不利はどーってことない」

en.html:
While Chachamaru and I talked, the battle kept moving.

Gunfire answered gunfire. Swords struck swords.
People died.

Just kept dying.
No end to it.

A life had the value of dust, of rubbish. Say no, shout no, say it as fiercely as you liked. Lives were still becoming dust and rubbish in front of you. Your objection could do nothing.

This was a battlefield.
A whole world called battlefield. Here, that was how the value was decided.

ja.html:
俺と茶々丸が話す間にも、戦況は進展してゆく。

　銃火が交わされ、刀剣が打ち合わされ――
　人が死ぬ。

　ひたすらに死んでゆく。
　際限もなく死んでゆく。

　生命の価値は塵芥であった。
　誰がそれに対して否定の叫びを上げようと、事実、
塵となり芥となって失われてゆく生命の前には無力で
あった。

　ここは戦場。
　戦場という世界なのだ。
